acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Fae family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Sprite, T2, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Petal-Fan Soldier (Soldier) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two fire construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Knee-high Sprite with layered petal wings, garland clothing, thorn blade, and a faint aura of motes.
Signature mechanic: Garland Fan: layered petals close outer-to-inner while the thorn blade traces the same narrowing lane.
battlefieldDuty: Repeat fan-shaped pressure by folding layered petal wings around a knee-high thorn advance.
constructionDimensions: Material/structure branches: T1 the palm-sized body, simple insect wings, and thorn grip gain one ceramic ember bead; T2 layered petal wings gain char-edged seams; T3 stained glass and branch antlers gain heat-black ribs; T4 gown, mask, and mote court gain cooling thorn clasps; T5 impossible geometry, season crown, and reality bend gain bounded ignition facets.

Motion/process branches: T1 the palm-sized thorn feint vents one dust-sized combustion cycle between insect wings; T2 layered petals burn outer-to-inner; T3 stained glass and antlers redirect heat along one pane; T4 the gown and mask court cycle smoke through a clasp; T5 the season crown ignites and cools one stable reality facet.
counterplay: Cross behind the outer petal and strike the inner wing seam after the blade passes. Affinity signal: Affinity counterplay branches: T1 the palm-sized thorn grip exposes its ember-bead vent after the insect-wing feint; T2 a layered petal seam opens its cooling gap after combustion; T3 stained glass and antlers expose the cooling pane after heat transfer; T4 the gown and mask court expose a cooling clasp after smoke cycles; T5 the season crown and impossible reality facet expose an ignition break between cycles.
identityInvariants: A slender weightless-looking silhouette retains layered wings while scale, head growth, and proportion change only at explicit tiers.
Spring green, petal pink, dusk violet, moth iridescence, and bounded gold pollen light remain source palette rather than affinity evidence.
Living leaf, petal, spider silk, stained glass, bark, dew, and moth wing remain discrete ordinary or uncanny materials.
Wing complexity and subtly wrong beauty escalate from a palm sprite to a sovereign whose geometry bends the surrounding frame.
telegraph: Garland clothing draws tight and the outer petal layer tilts toward the selected side.
